purpose: Lightroom vibrance response tables of the production model (VibranceModel.h)

method.excluded: encoded channel <= 0.002 or >= 0.995 in either export; L <= 0.08; tables: Oklab C <= 0.01; near-grey factor: 0.001 < C <= 0.016
method.monotone: isotonic per cell on each side of zero (chroma)
method.cross_validation: two folds of alternate scenes; gap = predicted - LR mean chroma ratio
